notes.title: 1,000 wishlists and demo release date! Thank you for your support!
notes.notes:
As a solo developer, it's incredibly exciting for me to see that over 1,000 people are genuinely interested in my first Steam release.



Overcome Your Fears will participate in the upcoming Steam Next Fest!

On October 13th, a short demo version will be released that will let you experience the overall atmosphere of the game. I would be incredibly grateful if you play it and leave your feedback.



Also, for those who want to chat, I've created a Discord server. I'd be happy to see you there - discord.gg/PP85J9mC7g



More to come! Once again, thank you so much for your attention to the game - every Wishlist and Follow is incredibly motivating!
